paths.name: @tanstack/react-query
paths.message: TanStack Query is read-side only in Trove. Writes go through queueOfflineMutation/syncOfflineMutations in lib/offline/trip-sync.ts, which owns the offline queue, conflict states and replay. A second write path would race it.

paths.name: lucide-react
paths.message: Concept icons come from '@/lib/icons' (import * as Icons from '@/lib/icons'), so each Trove concept keeps one glyph. See docs/brand/README.md.
